item.title: New ‘JoJo,’ Period Dramas, And Steampunk Adventures: Netflix Outlines Its 2026 Anime Lineup
item.description: A 2026 lineup blending new originals and updates to legacy franchises underscores how Netflix views anime as both cultural export and business engine.

item.title: Zack Olin Named SVP Of Development And Current Series At Disney TV Animation
item.description: Olin will work to shape creative strategies and supporting ongoing productions behind series such as 'Big City Greens' and 'Phineas and Ferb.'

item.title: Better Late Than Never? ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Finally Gets A Major Toy Rollout
item.description: Mattel and Hasbro unveil expansive toy lines tied to Netflix and Sony’s animated hit in a merchandise push that arrived long after the film broke out.

item.title: ‘Here’s The Plan’ Director Fernanda Frick Returns To Animation With ‘Last Journey’ Teaser (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: After taking time to finish her graphic novel 'Raise the Bar,' formerly a series project at Netflix, Frick returns to animation with the stop-motion teaser.

item.title: Former Paramount Co-CEO Brian Robbins Goes Digital First With His New Label, Big Shot Pictures, Acquires ‘Eloise’ Rights
item.description: The former Paramount and Nickelodeon executive has launched a digital-first kids and family studio, blending YouTube incubation with a Sony theatrical deal.

item.title: Animation Dominates 2025 Streaming: ‘Bluey’ Repeats As Nielsen’s Most-Watched Title
item.description: 'Bluey' was the year's most watched anything, 'KPop Demon Hunters' took the top film prize, and Seth MacFarlane won Streaming Icon of the Year.

item.title: Netflix Becomes Maximum-Level Patron Of Blender’s Development Fund
item.description: The streamer pledged at least €240,000/year, reinforcing Blender’s position as a professional, open-source tool for high-end animation pipelines.

item.title: Blue Ant Media Finalizes Its Takeover Of Thunderbird Entertainment, Including Atomic Cartoons
item.description: Atomic's leadership will remain in place to lead Blue Ant's animation division, expanding the company’s production scale and global reach.

item.title: Expanded ‘Disney Afternoon Collection’ Of ’80s And ’90s Console Favorites Is Heading To Switch And Switch 2
item.description: Expanding on the 2017 console collection and bringing it to handheld devices, this new 8-pack is bonkers, yeah, totally nuts.

item.title: Adult Swim Promotes Cameron Tang To SVP Role
item.description: Tang has been with Adult Swim since 2012, and will lead development and current series, steering the network’s next wave of originals.
